name: Markdown Plugin
description: Markdown file preview viewer with multi-tab support. Renders .md files via marked.parse() with custom Renderer (sanitizes raw HTML by escaping < and >, strips javascript: links). Multi-tab with per-tab scroll tracking (scrollTops map). External file change auto-reload preserving scroll position. Handles empty files, deleted files, and render errors gracefully. State serialization includes legacy single-file format migration. Drag-to-reorder tabs. Right-click tab context menu with Close, Close Others, Close All, and Copy File Path actions.

dependencies.usage: Tab right-click context menu — renders Close, Close Others, Close All, separator, and Copy File Path actions

interface.constructor: constructor(container: HTMLElement) — Creates editor-wrap DOM structure (.editor-tab-bar > .editor-tab-scroll + .md-preview). Registers document-level dragend listener to clean drag visual state. Sets up wheel stopPropagation on preview pane. Registers file change listener via fs.onChanged to auto-reload tabs when files change externally.

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Normalizes path (backslashes to forward slashes, lowercases for key). If tab already exists, switches to it. Otherwise reads file content via IPC fs:readFile, pushes new Tab to tabs array, initializes scrollTop to 0, and switches to the new tab.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serializes current markdown state: openFiles (array of file paths), activeFile (lowercased key), scrollTops (per-file scroll position map). Saves active tab's scroll position before reading. Returns null if no tabs are open.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores markdown state from serialized data. Handles legacy single-file format ({loadedFile, scrollTop}) by migrating to multi-tab format. Normalizes all paths (lowercase, forward slashes). Pushes all open files as tabs, switches to activeFile.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from fs.onChanged file watcher to prevent memory leaks. Clears unsubFileChanged reference.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Display title for the markdown plugin card header. Defaults to empty string.

properties.name: onDestroy
properties.description: Callback fired when the plugin is destroyed. Set by CanvasArea to handle card cleanup.

state.description: Serialized to .cockpit/window.json as part of canvas save state. Includes legacy format migration for single-file state.

fields.name: openFiles
fields.description: Array of lowercased file paths for all open markdown tabs

fields.name: activeFile
fields.description: Lowercased file path of the currently active tab, or empty string if none

fields.name: scrollTops
fields.description: Per-file scroll position map, keyed by lowercased file path

features.multi_tab_viewer: Multiple .md files open simultaneously in tabs with per-tab scroll position tracked in scrollTops map. Active tab switch preserves scroll of previous tab
features.markdown_rendering: Content rendered via marked.parse() with breaks:true. Custom Renderer escapes raw HTML (< → <, > → >) and strips javascript: protocol links for XSS prevention
features.file_watch: fs.onChanged listener auto-reloads open tabs when files change externally, preserving scroll position for inactive tabs
features.drag_reorder: Tab reordering via HTML5 drag-and-drop (dragstart/dragenter/dragover/dragleave/drop events on .editor-tab elements)
features.tab_context_menu: Right-click on tab shows ContextMenu with Close, Close Others, Close All, separator, and Copy File Path (copies original path via IPC clipboard:writeText)
features.middle_click_close: Middle mouse button (button === 1) on a tab closes it
features.scroll_preservation: Per-tab scroll position saved to scrollTops map on tab switch and restored when switching back
features.legacy_migration: restoreState detects legacy single-file format ({loadedFile, scrollTop}) and migrates to multi-tab format transparently

lifecycle.created_by: CanvasArea.addMarkdown() — instantiated when user creates a new markdown card via button or context menu
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Card terminate → MarkdownPlugin.destroy() — unsubscribes file watcher, then DOM is removed by PluginCard
